amp.dist_err_no_signal_range: Signal too weak: the anode current barely changes across the signal window — Ia %{imin}…%{imax} mA, fundamental %{b1} mA (min 0.01). The load line crosses the curves where they carry almost the same current: check Ra units (the spin is in kΩ), move the bias to a steeper region, or increase Ub/swing.
amp.dist_err_bias_outside_data_range: Ug1 bias %{bias} V is outside the measured Ug1 range: %{lo}…%{hi} V for the current Ug2 slice. Set Ug1 inside this range.
amp.dist_err_bias_at_data_edge_range: Ug1 bias %{bias} V is too close to the edge of the measured Ug1 range (%{lo}…%{hi} V) — no room for signal swing. Move Ug1 toward the middle.
amp.Needs_Ug2_prompt:
Pentode model selected, but the measurements do not carry a valid Ug2 value (sensor failure or triode-format data). Please specify the screen voltage to use for analysis.

Suggested (from lamp config): %{suggested} V
amp.analysis_failed: Analysis could not be computed. Check parameters and scan data.
amp.auto_q_tip:
Sweep all Ug1 values and pick the bias with minimum THD.
Use after setting Ub and Ra.
amp.cf_rk_tip:
Cathode resistor (kΩ).
Determines DC operating point and feedback.
amp.cf_rl_tip:
AC load resistor (kΩ).
Resistance seen by the cathode follower output.
amp.chebyshev_limited: Chebyshev: HD2–HD%{n} (need more Ug1 curves for higher harmonics)
amp.circuit_type_tip:
Amplifier circuit topology.
SE: Single-Ended with resistive load.
SE Transformer: Single-Ended with transformer (DC Q-point at Ua≈Ub, AC swing beyond Ub). Use for output stages.
CF: Cathode Follower (gain ≈ 1, low Zout).
PP: Push-Pull (even harmonics cancelled, 2× power).
amp.class_a_mode_tip:
Push-pull class-A region filter.
Off: no constraint.
Absolute: minimum P_A in watts.
% of Pout: P_A as fraction of point's max output.
amp.class_a_value_tip:
Class-A power threshold for PP: P_A = Iq² × Ra_aa / 8.
The PP amp stays in class A up to this output power, then transitions to AB. Filter excludes points below this.
amp.copy_results: Copy results to clipboard (Ctrl+C in results area)
amp.data_source_tip: Which data to use for analysis: measured points or fitted model curves.
amp.dist_err_bias_at_data_edge: Ug1 bias is at the edge of measured data — no swing room. Move bias toward the centre of the Ug1 range.
amp.dist_err_bias_outside_data: Ug1 bias is outside the measured Ug1 range. Adjust Ug1 to a value covered by scan data.
amp.dist_err_few_intersections: Load line crosses fewer than 3 measurement curves. Check Ub/Ra so the load line stays inside scanned Ua×Ia region.
amp.dist_err_manual_swing_clipped: Manual swing pushes the tube into the negative-current region. Reduce swing or move bias.
amp.dist_err_manual_swing_small: Manual swing is too small (< 0.1 V). Increase Swing or set it to Auto.
amp.dist_err_no_signal: Signal too weak: i_max ≈ i_min over the chosen swing. Increase swing or pick a steeper part of the curve.
amp.dist_err_pp_no_composite: Push-pull composite characteristic has fewer than 5 valid points. Widen the Ug1 scan range or check tube B data.
amp.dist_err_pp_no_swing: Push-pull composite swing is near zero. Adjust bias or swing.
amp.dist_err_pp_ra_invalid: Push-pull per-tube load impedance is invalid. Check Ra_aa value.
amp.dist_err_sparse_data: Swing window contains fewer than 3 measured Ug1 curves — non-linearity not detectable. Widen the swing or scan with a finer Ug1 step.
amp.dist_err_unknown: Analysis failed. Bias or swing likely landed in a region where the curve produces near-zero fundamental — try a different operating point.
amp.enable_ll:
Load Line is off.
Enable Load Line in Plot Options to activate amplifier analysis.
amp.gain_na: Gain: N/A (not enough data near Q-point)
amp.hd_method_tip:
Harmonic distortion calculation method.
Auto: Chebyshev for measurements, DFT for models.
Chebyshev: polynomial decomposition (best for measured data).
DFT: FFT on synthetic waveform (best for models).
5-point: classic Radiotron method (HD2/HD3 only).
amp.insufficient_signal:
Insufficient signal for reliable THD.
The operating point is near cutoff or the available swing is too small.
amp.nfb_line: NFB %{nfb_db} dB → Gain=%{gain} (%{gain_db} dB)  Zout=%{zout} kΩ  THD=%{thd}%  DF=%{df}  BW ×%{bw}
amp.nfb_spin_tip: Negative feedback amount (dB). Reduces distortion and output impedance at the cost of gain.
amp.no_data:
No data.
1. Run a scan or load a measurement.
2. Enable Load Line (Plot Options or set Ub/Ra here).
3. The tab updates automatically.
amp.not_enough_isects:
Not enough intersections (need ≥ 3 Ug1 curves).
• Adjust Ub / Ra so the load line crosses more curves
• Or scan a wider Ug1 range.
amp.opt_apply_best_tip: Apply optimizer's best point (Ub, Ug2, Ug1, Ra, swing) to the manual analysis parameters.
amp.opt_balanced_tip: Trade-off between THD and Pout. score = THD − weight·log₁₀(Pout_mW). Adjust the weight in the field below.
amp.opt_balanced_weight_tip:
Higher = prefer more output power. Lower = prefer lower THD.
Formula: score = THD − w·log₁₀(Pout_mW)
0.0 ≈ Min THD mode
0.5 = default (slight Pout preference)
5–10 = noticeable Pout preference
20 = strong Pout preference (near Max Pout mode)
amp.opt_enable_tip:
Switch left plot to Pareto front (THD vs Pout).
Shows all feasible operating points and the optimal trade-off curve.
amp.opt_max_pout_tip: Pick the operating point with the highest output power. THD ignored — may be high.
amp.opt_method_note: HD method: 5-point (fixed for grid sweep speed)
amp.opt_min_thd_tip: Pick the operating point with the lowest THD. Combine with Pout min to avoid degenerate small-swing wins.
amp.opt_pout_min_tip: Minimum output power constraint (W). 0 = no constraint.
amp.opt_thd_max_tip: Maximum THD constraint (%). 0 = no constraint. With target 'Max Pout' this answers the datasheet question 'Pout at X% THD': the swing sweep and refinement push output power up to the THD limit.
amp.opt_ra_tip:
Sweep Ra (10%–1000% of current) and pick the value with minimum THD.
Keeps current bias point.
amp.opt_run_tip:
Run grid sweep + parallel Pareto refinement.
Sweeps Ug1 × Ra × Swing (and Ub if range set).
amp.opt_target_tip:
Optimization scoring criterion. Determines which point becomes 'best'.
• Min THD: minimize harmonic distortion (lowest THD wins).
• Max Pout: maximize output power (highest Pout wins).
• Balanced: trade-off  score = THD − w·log₁₀(Pout_mW)  (lower wins). Default w = 0.5; see 'Balance weight' field.
amp.opt_top_n_tip: Open a sortable table of Pareto candidates with their parameters and metrics; pick one to apply.
amp.opt_warn_dft_no_model_fallback: DFT requested but no tube model fitted — used Chebyshev. Fit a model (Koren/Dempwolf/Reefman) for full HD spectrum.
amp.opt_warn_ug2_filter_no_match: Ug2 filter matched no measured points — the analysis fell back to ALL screen levels mixed together; results are suspect. Pick a Ug2 level that exists in the data.
amp.opt_warn_pp_dft_ug2_from_data: PP DFT without a selected Ug2 level — the model screen voltage was taken from the measured data (median Ug2). Select a Ug2 level for exact results.
amp.opt_warn_se_xfmr_no_model: SE transformer without a fitted model: the load line is approximated from Ub (real anode swing goes above the supply, beyond measured data). Fit a model for accurate transformer results.
amp.pa_max_tip:
Maximum rated anode dissipation (W).
Used for thermal limit checks in results.
amp.pp_matched_tip:
Assume both tubes are identical (mirror curves).
Uncheck to select a specific second tube from loaded data.
amp.pp_no_tube_b:
No second tube data.
For mismatched PP analysis:
1. Load a second measurement via Compare tab → 'Show on main plot'
2. Or import data via File → Import.
3. Then select it as Tube B.

Or enable Matched pair to use mirrored curves.
amp.pp_ra_dc_tip: DC resistance of one half-primary winding (kΩ). Each tube sees its own half. Affects DC Q-point: Ua_q ≈ Ub − Iq · ra_dc.
amp.pp_raa_tip:
Anode-to-anode reflected impedance (kΩ).
Each tube sees Ra_aa/4 as effective load.
amp.pp_tube_b_tip:
Select the second tube for Push-Pull pair.
Load measurements via Compare tab or File → Import first.
amp.ra_dc_tip: DC resistance of transformer primary winding (kΩ)
amp.section_circuit_tip:
Amplifier topology: Single-Ended, SE Transformer,
Cathode Follower, or Push-Pull.
amp.section_optimizer_tip:
Multi-parameter optimizer. Sweeps Ug1 × Ra (and Ub for models)
to find the best operating point for given constraints.
Shows Pareto front: THD vs Pout trade-off curve.
amp.section_params_tip:
Operating point parameters: supply voltage, load resistance,
bias point, signal swing, thermal limit, and NFB.
amp.section_results_tip:
Analysis results for the current operating point.
Q-point, distortion, power, gain, impedance.
amp.section_source_tip:
Select measurement series, data sources (measured / model),
and harmonic distortion calculation method.
amp.show_gzp_tip:
Show Gain, output impedance (Zout) and anode dissipation (Pa)
on the Ra sweep plot. Pa_max limit shown as dotted line.
amp.show_hd45_tip:
Show 4th and 5th harmonics on plots.
Available with Chebyshev or DFT method (not 5-point).
amp.source_tip:
Data source for analysis.
'Current scan' = active measurement.
Overlay / imported data also available if loaded.
amp.swing_clamped: Swing limited by available data: requested ±%{requested}V, used ±%{used}V.
amp.ub_tip:
Supply voltage B+ (V) in the anode-cathode domain of the measured curves.
Fixed bias: Ub = B+ directly.
Cathode bias: enter Ub = B+ − Vk (Vk = Rk·(Ia+Ig2)); the datasheet's Va is usually already this value.
Resistive: the load line crosses Ia=0 here. Transformer: the DC line sits here and the anode swings ABOVE it (up to ~2×Ub).
amp.ul_pentode_tip: 0% — Pentode (Ug2 fixed at nominal). Maximum Pout, highest THD.
amp.ul_sweep_mode_tip:
Sweep UL screen-tap fraction in optimizer.
• Off: use single value from 'UL tap' field.
• Presets: try selected historical taps (Williamson 43%, Quad 50%, etc.).
• Custom: equally-spaced steps across [min..max].
• Presets + range: union of both.
Only affects DFT method (other methods use composite from data).
amp.ul_tap_tip: Ultralinear screen tap (%). 0=pentode, 18-43=UL, 100=triode. Requires model. Typical: EL84≈20%, EL34≈40%, KT88≈43%.
amp.ul_triode_tip: 100% — Triode connection (Ug2 = Ua). Lowest Pout, lowest THD.
amp.ul_williamson_tip: 43% — Williamson 1947 / Mullard 5-10. Most common, best classic compromise.
amp.warn_model_fallback: Model '%{source}' not found — results computed from raw measurements
amp.warn_ug2_filter_empty: Ug2 filter %{ug2} V matched no points — all Ug2 levels are mixed, results are suspect
amp.b_extrap_notice: Ia(B): the lower branch of the analyzed swing reaches %{span} V beyond tube B's measured Ug1 range - extrapolated to cutoff.
amp.warn_pp_b_edge_extrapolated: Tube B's data edge is far from cutoff (Ia at edge = %{edge_pct}% of the analyzed signal amplitude): the extrapolated tail materially shapes the composite - rescan tube B to deeper Ug1 for accurate PP numbers.
amp.warn_dft_no_model: DFT requested without a fitted model — fell back to 5-point
amp.warn_pa_avg_not_converged: Pa avg: %{n} samples did not converge — value may be inaccurate
amp.warn_dft_newton_not_converged: DFT: %{n}/%{n_samples} samples did not converge — THD may be biased near clipping
amp.opt_warn_refine_unavailable: scipy is not available — refinement skipped, showing raw grid optimum
amp.opt_warn_refine_failed: Refinement failed — showing raw grid optimum (see log)
amp.opt_warn_nm_not_converged: Refinement did not fully converge — the optimum is the best point found, not a verified minimum
amp.warn_ul_tap_ignored_by_method: UL tap is set but the 5-point method computes on measured data — the tap is NOT reflected in THD/Pout. Use DFT or Chebyshev.
amp.opt_warn_ul_sweep_skipped: UL tap sweep skipped — it needs a fitted model and DFT/Chebyshev/auto HD method.
amp.p1_line: P1 (fundamental): %{p1} W — what an external meter reads
amp.opt_err_no_valid_points: No valid points: every grid point failed distortion evaluation. Check the Ug2 level selection, widen the Ug1/Ra ranges, or increase the swing.
amp.opt_err_no_points_within_constraints: No points satisfy the constraints: all candidates exceed Pa max or fall below Pout min. Relax the constraints or widen the ranges.
amp.opt_err_no_points_within_thd_cap: No points satisfy the THD limit: candidates pass the Pa/Pout constraints but exceed THD max at every evaluated swing. Raise the THD limit or increase the swing steps.
amp.opt_warn_dft_mismatched_pair: Mismatched pair (tube B data): model-based DFT/UL evaluates a MATCHED pair — computed on the data composite instead; UL sweep unavailable.

health.Reserve_tooltip:
Cathode reserve from the emission sweep: how far the heater can sag before Ia leaves the space-charge plateau.
The knee is the intersection of the fitted plateau and emission-branch lines (Miram method); the sweep descends adaptively to the 50% floor before giving up.
Engineering guides (not factory thresholds):
≥N (lower bound) — knee not reached down to the sweep floor: excellent, typical for a fresh cathode
30–50% — knee found deep: healthy cathode
15–30% — emitter noticeably consumed, watch the trend between runs
< 15% — depletion is near: emission will soon sag at nominal heater too.
The knee migrating UP between runs is the primary wear signal; ⚠ means the knee was only bracketed (low confidence).

tip.Curves_X_Ua:
Anode voltage Ua (V)

Curves grouped by Ug1 (one curve per Ug1 value).
Shows how parameter changes along the output characteristic.
tip.Curves_X_Ug1:
Grid voltage Ug1 (V)

Curves grouped by Ua (one curve per Ua value).
Shows how parameter changes along the transfer characteristic.
tip.Curves_X_Ug2:
Screen grid voltage Ug2 (V)

Only for raw parameters (Ia, Ig2, Pa, Pig2, Ia/Ig2).
Requires data at multiple Ug2 values.
Shows pentode behavior vs screen voltage.
Useful for UL tap selection and Ug2 optimization.
tip.Curves_Y_Gm:
Transconductance Gm = dIa/dUg1 (mA/V)

How much Ia changes per volt of Ug1.
Higher Gm = higher gain potential.
Computed as finite difference from Ia grid.
tip.Curves_Y_Ia:
Anode current Ia (mA)

Direct measured value.
Same data as 2D plot, different axis arrangement.
tip.Curves_Y_Ia_Ig2:
Current ratio Ia/Ig2 (dimensionless)

Ratio of anode current to screen current.
Higher = more efficient pentode operation.
Below 3:1 — risk of screen grid overheating.
Useful for finding safe pentode operating points.
tip.Curves_Y_Ig2:
Screen grid current Ig2 (mA)

Current flowing to the screen grid (pentodes/tetrodes).
High Ig2 at low Ua indicates knee region danger.
tip.Curves_Y_Pa:
Anode power dissipation Pa = Ua × Ia / 1000 (W)

Power dissipated on the anode plate.
Must stay below Pa_max to avoid damage.
Useful for finding safe operating area.
tip.Curves_Y_Pig2:
Screen power dissipation Pig2 = Ug2 × Ig2 / 1000 (W)

Power dissipated on the screen grid.
Often the weakest point in pentodes.
Exceeding Pig2_max causes screen damage.
tip.Curves_Y_Rp:
Plate resistance Rp = dUa/dIa (kΩ)

How much Ua must change to produce 1 mA of Ia change.
Lower Rp = better current source behavior.
Computed as finite difference from Ia grid.
tip.Curves_Y_mu:
Amplification factor μ = Gm × Rp

Voltage gain of an unloaded stage.
Ideal triode: μ is nearly constant.
Flatness of μ curve indicates tube linearity.

tip.Health_match_algorithm:
Pair-matching strategy (group size 2 only):

Tightest-first (greedy) — picks globally closest pair first,
locks both, repeats. Best for 'select N best pairs from a
box of tubes and return the rest' — never sacrifices a tight
pair to balance the overall sum.

Optimal sum (Hungarian) — scipy linear_sum_assignment.
Minimises total distance across all pairs. Best when you
must place every tube into some pair within Max Δ.

Each: match anodes independently.

tip.Health_match_max_delta:
Maximum allowed distance between tubes in a group.
0 = no limit. Groups exceeding this are moved to unmatched.
tip.Health_match_mode:
Groups: partition all tubes into matched pairs/quads.
Similar to: rank all tubes by distance from a reference tube.
tip.Health_match_protocol:
What "matched" has to mean for the target amplifier.
Strict: only measurements taken under identical conditions are compared.
Shared bias: one bias feeds both tubes — pairs are additionally gated by the predicted quiescent-current imbalance.
Individual bias: separate bias per tube — Ia is ignored, tubes are matched by S and R.
tip.Health_match_tube_mode:
Measurement mode to use for matching.
Pentode and triode-connected modes produce different S and R values
and must not be mixed.
tip.Health_match_use:
Latest: use the most recent measurement per lamp.
Best: use the measurement with the highest Health Index.
tip.Health_match_weight_ia:
Weight of Ia (anode current) in distance calculation.
Higher = Ia differences matter more.
tip.Health_match_weight_ia_ignored: Ia weight is ignored with individual bias: each tube gets its own bias, so the quiescent current is set by the amplifier, not by the tube.
tip.Health_match_weight_r:
Weight of R (plate resistance) in distance calculation.
Higher = R differences matter more.
tip.Health_match_weight_s:
Weight of S (transconductance) in distance calculation.
Higher = S differences matter more.

tip.Health_plan_delta_ug1:

tip.Health_plan_delta_ug2:
Voltage offset for Sg2 measurement (Ug2 ± δVg2).

tip.SRK_sweep:
Sweep Ug1 with fine step (mini-scan) for higher S precision.
Step size is set in app.json (srk_ug1_step, default 0.04V).
With step 0.04V in a 0.48V zone: 13 Ug1 × 2 Ua = 26 points.
Linear regression over many points reduces random error.
Relative S error < 1% vs ~5% with classic 4-point method.

Hardware basis: ATmega16 10-bit ADC, Ug1 charge pump.
Min reliable step: 0.04V (≥1 ADC LSB per step).
Each point: N-sample Ia averaging (srk_samples).
tip.Samples:
Number of Ia/Ig2 readings per point.
Higher = less noise, slower scan.
1 = single read, 2–5 recommended.

Generate an .asc schematic with DC sweep
for verifying the model in LTSpice.
tip.Start_preheat:
Start heater warmup.
Sets Uh/Ih and waits for the specified time.
When finished — tube is ready for measurement.
tip.Stop_scan:
Stop the current scan.
Collected points can be saved.
tip.Sweep_Ug2:
Pentode/Tetrode mode: Ug2 sweeps independently.
Use for measuring pentodes and tetrodes
where screen grid has a fixed voltage.
tip.Tab_2D:
Output characteristics Ia(Ua)

Shows anode current vs anode voltage.
Each curve represents a fixed Ug1 value.
Color indicates Ug2 level (viridis colormap).

Overlays: Pa max hyperbola, Ua/Ia max zones, load line.
tip.Tab_Amplifier:
Amplifier design analysis

Shows THD/Pout vs signal amplitude and distortion vs load resistance.
Auto Q finds optimal bias. Optimize Ra finds optimal load.
Enable Load Line to activate.
tip.Tab_Contour:
Contour map Ia(Ua, Ug1)

Shows anode current as a color intensity map
for a selected Ug2 slice.
X axis: Ua (V), Y axis: Ug1 (V).
Bright areas = high Ia, dark areas = low Ia.
tip.Tab_Curves:
Parametric curves viewer

Plots Gm, Rp, μ, Ia, or Ig2 as line curves.
Select Y-axis parameter and X-axis variable.
Each curve represents a fixed stepping value.

Gm = dIa/dUg1 — transconductance (mA/V)
Rp = dUa/dIa — plate resistance (kΩ)
μ = Gm × Rp — amplification factor

Useful for:
  • Reading exact Gm/Rp/μ values at operating points
  • Evaluating parameter stability across the range
  • Comparing tube quality via μ flatness
tip.Tab_Gm_Rp:
Transconductance, plate resistance, and amplification factor maps

Gm = dIa/dUg1 (mA/V) — transconductance at each point.
Rp = dUa/dIa (kΩ) — plate resistance at each point.
µ = Gm × Rp — amplification factor.
Use the selector above the right plot to switch between Rp and µ.
Color intensity shows the parameter value.
tip.Tab_Pa_map:
Anode power dissipation map

Shows Pa = Ua × Ia as a heatmap.
Bright areas = high power dissipation.
Pa_max contour shows the safe operating limit.
tip.Tab_Transfer:
Transfer characteristics Ia(Ug1)

Shows anode current vs grid voltage for each anode voltage (Ua).
Each curve represents a fixed Ua value.
The slope of each curve is the transconductance S = dIa/dUg1 (mA/V).

Color coding:
  • Single measurement — color by Ug2 (viridis colormap)
  • Multiple measurements — color by source (lamp)

Useful for:
  • Evaluating transconductance (S) visually
  • Comparing linearity at different operating points
  • Assessing tube matching by overlay
tip.Trace_COM:
Enable COM exchange logging.
All commands are written to logs/com_trace.log.
Useful for protocol debugging.
tip.Track_Ug2:
Triode mode: Ug2 = Ua + offset.
Use for measuring triodes or pentodes/tetrodes
in triode connection (screen grid tied to anode).
Set offset = 0 for direct triode connection.
tip.Transfer_view:
Preset for the visible Ua slices:
All — every measured Ua.
Datasheet — 5 evenly spaced slices (incl. min/max).
Load line — the slice nearest to Ub ± one neighbor.
Editing the Ua list by hand switches to Custom.
tip.UTD_output:
Output curves: Va on X axis, Vg as stepping parameter.
Most common format for uTracer tools (90%+ usage).
tip.UTD_transfer:
Transfer curves: Vg on X axis, Va as stepping parameter.
Used for transconductance measurements.
tip.Heatmap_lock:
Freeze the color scale of all heatmaps at the current levels.
With auto-levels the palette re-stretches on every render, so two scans are not color-comparable.
Uncheck to return to auto-levels.
tip.Ua_max:
Show maximum anode voltage zone.
Draws a vertical red line and shades the area
to the right (exceeding Ua max) on the 2D plot.
Value is auto-filled from lamp config if available.
tip.Ug2_as_color:
Plot Ia(Ua) with Ug2 encoded as curve color (viridis).
This is the standard output characteristic view.
tip.Ug2_as_series:
Plot Ia(Ua) with each Ug2 value as a discrete color family.
Legend shows Ug2 values. Pa_max and load line remain active.
tip.Ug2_calc_combo: Select Ug2 slice for contour/Gm/Rp/Pa calculations.
tip.Ug2_slice:
Select a specific Ug2 value for the contour plot.
Auto = use the most common Ug2 value.
tip.Warmup_seconds:
Heater warmup time in seconds.
60–180s is typical.
tip.Zone_measure: Measure SRK in the selected zone immediately.
tip.Zone_ua_max: Maximum Ua in SRK measurement zone.
tip.Zone_ua_min: Minimum Ua in SRK measurement zone.
tip.Zone_ug1_max: Maximum Ug1 in SRK measurement zone.
tip.Zone_ug1_min: Minimum Ug1 in SRK measurement zone.
tip.Zone_ug2: Ug2 value used for SRK zone measurements.
tip.Spice_flow: Lower −3 dB frequency for the output transformer model: primary inductance L1 = Ra / (2π·f_low). Lower f_low → bigger transformer.
tip.Spice_pp_tube_a: Data series used to fit tube A (and the single-tube model for SE/CF).
tip.Spice_pp_tube_b: Push-Pull tube B: 'matched' reuses tube A's model; picking a series fits a separate model (mismatched pair).
tip.Health_plan_emission_mode: Single point: one reduced-heater probe (fast). Sweep: walk Ia(Uh) down and locate the space-charge knee — far more discriminating, but adds one stabilization wait per step.
tip.Health_plan_bias_servo: Before measuring S, adjust Ug1 until Ia equals the reference current. Transconductance depends on anode current, so comparing S taken at a different current mixes wear with a shifted operating point. Also reports the bias shift itself.
tip.Health_result_bias: Bias servo outcome: the bias that produced the reference current (Δ = shift from the plan bias). A shifted bias with normal S points at grid contamination / contact-potential drift; combined with low emission it means cathode wear. Plan-point Ia is the deficit the servo compensated.

utd.Output_curves: Output curves — Ia(Va) with Vg stepping
utd.Transfer_curves: Transfer curves — Ia(Vg) with Va stepping
utd.Vs_Vh_warning: Note: Vs (screen voltage) and Vh (heater) are not stored in .utd format. Vs is encoded in the filename by convention (e.g. EL84_250.utd).
utd.Export_holes: %{count} grid cell(s) had no measured point and were written as Ia=0.0 (curves cut by protection?)
